name: BSA Rocket 3 (A75)
engine: 740 cc air-cooled OHV triple, three carbs, points
intro: BSA's triple, sister to the Triumph Trident. Three carbs, three sets of points and an inclined engine.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
